items.distractor_fact: Statio autem meteorologica in vico proximo eodem die temperaturam {D}°C notavit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the weather station in the neighboring village recorded a temperature of {D}°C that same day.
items.entity_note: different place: a weather station in a neighboring village, not the site of the morning/afternoon reading

items.distractor_fact: Pretium autem partis alterius societatis eodem die ${D} fuit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the share price of a different company was ${D} on the same day.
items.entity_note: different entity: another company's share, not the one whose open/close price is compared

items.distractor_fact: Altitudo autem aquae in flumine vicino eodem tempore {D}m fuit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the water level in the nearby river was {D}m at the same time.
items.entity_note: different place: a nearby river, not the reservoir whose level is compared month to month

items.distractor_fact: Altitudo autem alterius aeronavis automatae, quae simul volabat, {D}m erat.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the altitude of another drone, flying at the same time, was {D}m.
items.entity_note: different entity: another drone flying simultaneously, not the one whose initial/final altitude is compared

items.distractor_fact: Pondus autem alterius sarcinae, quae eodem die missa est, {D}kg erat.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the weight of another package, shipped the same day, was {D}kg.
items.entity_note: different entity: another package shipped the same day, not the one weighed before/after its journey

items.distractor_fact: Celeritas autem alterius machinae, in alio curru instructae, {D}km/h erat.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the speed of another engine, fitted in a different vehicle, was {D}km/h.
items.entity_note: different instrument: an engine in a different vehicle, not the one whose initial/final speed is compared

items.distractor_fact: Numerus autem punctorum alterius lusoris, in eodem ludo certantis, {D}pts erat.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile the point total of another player, competing in the same game, was {D}pts.
items.entity_note: different entity: another player's score, not the start/end score of the player in question

items.distractor_fact: Alius autem grex, in certamine diverso eodem tempore facto, puncta {D} per totum tempus accepit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile a different team, in a separate competition held at the same time, scored {D} goals over the season.
items.entity_note: different entity: another team in a different competition, not the team whose scored/conceded goals are compared

items.distractor_fact: Alius autem currus ferriviarius, in alia via ferrata, eodem die {D}min post mediam noctem pervenit.
items.gloss_en: Meanwhile another train, on a different line, arrived {D} minutes after midnight that same day.
items.entity_note: different entity/reference: another train on a different line, whose own schedule is not stated, so it cannot be read against this train's schedule
